}}'''Janina''' is a [[Wise One]] of the [[Miagoma]] [[Aiel]].

== Appearance ==
She has pale blue eyes with flaxen hair.

==Strength and Abilities==
Janina can [[channel]] not very strongly but still with considerable strength. In TWoTC her strength level is described as {{opsl|29}}, which is a middle-high ranking level among [[Aes Sedai]].

This strength is just a level below the minimum needed to open alone a gateway for [[Travel]]ing.

She has some proficiency with the [[Healing]] weaves.

== Activities ==
She is one of the six Wise Ones that [[travel]] to [[Ghealdan]] with [[Perrin Aybara]] to keep an eye out on [[Seonid Traighan]] and [[Masuri Sokawa]].

She is sent to [[Heal]] [[Aviellin]] after Aviellin receives a grievous injury. She assisted in the attack on the [[Shaido]] Aiel and the Wise Ones in the Battle of [[Malden]] to rescue [[Faile Bashere]].

In the making of ''[[Mah'alleinir]]'' by Perrin he is helped with the [[One Power]] provided by [[Neald]], [[Grady]] and all six the Wise Ones in his camp.

Later it can be assumed that she stays along [[Edarra]] with Perrin's forces in the [[Field of Merrilor]] to prepare for the [[Last Battle]]. After Perrin wakes up from falling to Slayer's arrow in Tel'Aran'Rhiod, he is treated by Janina at the medical camp in Mayene.
